register.labelZh: CAST 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: cast around 或 cast about 可以表示設法尋找答案或解決方法;cast your mind back 則表示刻意回想過去。；cast on 和 cast off 是編織圖樣和口頭指示中常見的重要表達。；cast somebody aside 表示拋棄某人;cast somebody out 則表示強迫某人離開某處或某個群體。；CAST 片語動詞可以描述物件被沖上岸、脫下衣物,以及某人垂低雙眼。
register.summaryEn: Cast around or cast about describes searching for an answer or solution. Cast your mind back describes deliberately remembering the past. Cast on and cast off are important expressions in knitting patterns and spoken instructions. Cast somebody aside describes abandoning someone, while cast somebody out describes forcing someone to leave a place or group. The CAST family can describe objects being washed ashore, clothes being removed and a person lowering their eyes.
